_comment: Scenario 1 - Shortcuts & tab switches (session #1, exam 'Mid shortcuts etc violations'). Event-level evaluation; timestamps are offsets from session start derived from proctor_logs.created_at - started_at (timezone-safe). Ground truth is database-corroborated: the 18:23:57 wall-clock event the annotator remembered as a keyboard shortcut was actually the third tab blur (TAB_SWITCH count:3), and right-clicks occurred only in the final burst. Consecutive same-type detections within 1s are treated as one physical event (the TAB_SWITCH+TAB_HIDDEN pair at 124.1/124.2). TAB_HIDDEN is merged into TAB_AWAY with TAB_SWITCH.
scenario: Scenario 1 - Tab switches, copy/paste shortcuts & right-clicks
